entries.en:
Controls how Defending with Double Armour is calculated:
	Minimum: never Defend with Double Armour
	Average: Damage Reduction from Defending with Double Armour is proportional to chance
	Maximum: always Defend with Double Armour

	Maximum：總是以雙重護甲防禦

entries.en:

Max Hit: Shows maximum hit for lining up all sources of ancestral boost.
entries.key: Controls how ancestrally boosted attacks are calculated: Average: Averages out Boost usage with cast time, attack speed and cooldown. Max Hit: Shows maximum hit for lining up all sources of ancestral boost.

entries.en:

	Average: damage is based on the average application, including both crits and non-crits
	Crits Only: damage is based solely on Ailments inflicted with crits
entries.key: Controls how the base damage for applying Ailments is calculated: Average: damage is based on the average application, including both crits and non-crits Crits Only: damage is based solely on Ailments inflicted with crits

	Crits Only：傷害僅依據暴擊造成的異常狀態

entries.en:
Controls how the chance on hit to ignore enemy physical damage reduction is calculated:
	Minimum: never ignores unless chance is at least 100%
	Average: damage is based on the average application
	Max Effect: always ignores if you have any chance
entries.key: Controls how the chance on hit to ignore enemy physical damage reduction is calculated: Minimum: never ignores unless chance is at least 100% Average: damage is based on the average application Max Effect: always ignores if you have any chance

	Minimum：除非機率至少達100%，否則永不忽略
	Average：傷害依照平均應用值計算
	Max Effect：只要有機率便始終忽略

entries.en:
Controls how the cooldown for skills is calculated:
	Base: The cooldown is calculated with normal behavior.
	Average: The cooldown is adjusted to reflect the average time between uses, factoring in effects such as a chance to not consume a cooldown.
entries.key: Controls how the cooldown for skills is calculated: Base: The cooldown is calculated with normal behavior. Average: The cooldown is adjusted to reflect the average time between uses, factoring in effects such as a chance to not consume a cooldown.
entries.zh:
控制技能冷卻時間如何計算：
	Base：冷卻時間以一般行為計算。
	Average：冷卻時間會依兩次使用間的平均時間調整，並考慮例如「有機率不消耗冷卻」等效果。
